cards.title: Add your baby to health insurance
cards.body: Having a baby is a qualifying life event, so you can likely add your baby to your health insurance by the deadline of 2026-10-29.

cards.title: California Paid Family Leave
cards.body: If you worked in California and paid into State Disability Insurance, you are likely eligible for up to 8 weeks of paid family leave.

cards.title: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job
cards.body: Some employers offer a Dependent Care FSA (a work account that lets you pay for childcare with pre-tax money). Check with your job to see whether yours does, and ask how long you have to sign up after your baby arrives.

sources.label: Dependent Care FSA: check with your job

cards.title: Federal Child Tax Credit
cards.body: You can likely claim up to $2,200.00 per child on your yearly tax return.

cards.title: Trump Account: $1,000 federal starter deposit
cards.body: Your child, born in 2025, is likely eligible for a $1,000 federal starter deposit.
